title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: The briefing passes: its billing, capacity controls, agent behavior and roadmap facts are supported by Microsoft documentation. Targeted searches found no documented switch dedicated to the agent node or automation for its human-assistance setting.

claims.claim: An agent node hands a workflow step to an AI agent that reasons, calls tools and returns a result.
